output.brief: Store 14's rise from 1.5% to 2.3% may be real or may be estimation noise, and the evidence does not yet say which. The interim figures are extrapolated from partial cycle counts with a margin of roughly ±0.6 points per quarter. Chain-wide, about half of stores with two consecutive interim rises were not confirmed by the year-end full count. The rise is spread across every department, and sales mix barely moved, so a mix shift is ruled out. The rise in recorded shoplifting incidents looks like an artifact of the new incident app: chain-wide recordings rose from 7.1 to 13.0 per store while chain shrink stayed flat. Neighbouring stores without self-checkout show no similar rise, but that is weak evidence given the noise. The ethics tip was checked against CCTV and was not substantiated. Recommendation: keep store 14 in the 7 December full count and hold off on guards, lane removal and personnel action until the count result is compared with the interim figures. Do not drop the store from the count, because that would remove the one measurement that settles this. Do not suspend the stocker. Confidence is moderate to good on the action, low on the cause.
